dedupe_keys.name: monitoring data from a pilot scale horizontal levee system

description: Monitoring Data from a Pilot-Scale Horizontal Levee System is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Aidan Cecchetti. Data was collected from a pilot-scale treatment wetland at the Oro Loma Sanitary District wastewater treatment facility in San Lorenzo, CA. This experimental system was completed in 2017 and was constructed to test a new type of treatment wetland known as the horizontal levee. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
